Package com.csse3200.game.tutorial

Class BattleTutorialPromptContent

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.tutorial.BattleTutorialPromptContent
public final class BattleTutorialPromptContent extends Object
Short battle teaching text for the guided tutorial to display at its chosen steps.

This class supplies content only. It does not define step order, progression, highlights, or when a prompt is shown.
